Hn induced by Fibonacci sequences OPENx1,…,xn) such that not both x1 and xn are equal to 1. Both, F​i​(n) and L​u​(n), are partial cubes; cf. [10].

8. Graphs on cycles
The Möbius ladder M2​m is a cubic circulant graph with 2​m vertices, formed from an m-cycle by adding edges connecting
opposite pairs of vertices in the cycle. We conjecture that M2​m is not 2-tr.embeddable and checked it for the Thomsen (or utility) graph M6=K3,3, Wagner graph M8 (both of diameter 2) and for M10 of diameter 3.
For even n> and increasing sequence a→=(a1,a2,…,ak) of odd numbers from [3,n−1],
we introduce the Generalised Chordal Ring G​C​R​(n,a→) as the graph obtained by adding to
the cycle C1,…,n, where each i is adjacent to i−1 and i+1 modulo n, the following edges:
(1) 
if i is even, then i is adjacent to i+almodn for 1≤l≤k;
(2) 
if i is odd, then i is adjacent to i−almodn for 1≤l≤k.
The cases k=1 and 2 correspond to known topologies: the Chordal Rings and Double Chordal Rings, respectively.
The Chordal Ring G​C​R​(n,a) is embeddable for a=1 and 3 (being Cn and P​r​i​s​mn2, respectively), but for a=5 and 7, G​C​R​(n,a) (of diameter d=3 and 4, respectively) is not (d−1)-tr.embeddable even for the smallest case n=2​a.

The Möbius ladder M2​m is a cubic circulant graph with 2​m vertices, formed from an m-cycle by adding edges connecting
opposite pairs of vertices in the cycle. We conjecture that M2​m is not 2-tr.embeddable and checked it for the Thomsen (or utility) graph M6=K3,3, Wagner graph M8 (both of diameter 2) and for M10 of diameter 3.
For even n> and increasing sequence a→=(a1,a2,…,ak) of odd numbers from [3,n−1],
we introduce the Generalised Chordal Ring G​C​R​(n,a→) as the graph obtained by adding to
the cycle C1,…,n, where each i is adjacent to i−1 and i+1 modulo n, the following edges:
(1) 
if i is even, then i is adjacent to i+almodn for 1≤l≤k;
(2) 
if i is odd, then i is adjacent to i−almodn for 1≤l≤k.
The cases k=1 and 2 correspond to known topologies: the Chordal Rings and Double Chordal Rings, respectively.
